question: Rendered as <Hello name="Ana" />, this shows the wrong thing. Why?
options: name is the whole props object
Props must be read with this.props
say: Rendered with name Ana, this component breaks. Why?
explanation: Without { } the first argument is the whole props object, not the name string. Write function Hello({ name }).
explainSay: Name is actually the whole props object. You forgot the curly braces. Write Hello with curly name.
